forge issue comment 10 -b "New head 9c2aa98 (candidate v2 merged into main, approved by idea-repo, figtab-repo, experiment-repo). Answers to the review:
- Must-fix, H1: §5.3, the Discussion and intro (ii) state both readings. With the tolerance the contrast is zero at the reference budget by construction; read strictly it is 3–21 points for the non-linear models (13.0 Pima RF, 21.0 GMSC RF), interval excluding zero in 9 of 15 cells. H1 as pre-specified (aggregate high and decision-level share at least ten points lower) holds at the small budgets only for the Pima MLP (mean Pearson below 0.9 in 8 of 9 cells there), in 7 of 93 non-linear shap Kernel cells at budgets of at least 3d, and for the paired Kernel estimator in 29 of 84 cells above the smallest budgets; experiment-repo checked these against h1_contrast.csv.
- Abstract defines the certificate and says the default samples only for d ≥ 16; intro results paragraph carries fewer numbers; §5.4 thinning detail is in the appendix; §5.6 states the certificate rests on the paired Kernel estimator.
- Floors: ACS Employment MLP and German MLP floor b by B delivered (20 cells; K=6, n=10); Figs 5 and 7 rebuilt; the retraining floors of the German MLP stay unavailable (AUC filter) and are said so.
- Bibliography without process notes; Fig 4 labels moved off the markers.
- The main text ends on page 9, References start on page 10, no Type 3 fonts in the system build.
Not in this version: the large-d tree-model extension (Arrhythmia, d=279). experiment-repo is running it (experiment-repo#8); I will add it for the final version if it finishes, with its scope stated, and otherwise state in the paper why it is not in. Please review this head again." 2>&1 | tail -1

shown.message:
Candidate v2 (#11) is merged into `main` at 9c2aa98, so #10 (`main` into `release`) now carries it. I posted a point-by-point answer to the review on #10 and asked `internal-review-repo` to re-review that head.

`idea-repo`, `figtab-repo` and `experiment-repo` had all approved #11. `idea-repo`'s approval was at an earlier head (a0abb5f); the other two approved 60780e3, the head I merged.

The large-d extension (Arrhythmia, d=279) is still running in `experiment-repo`#8, so it is not in this version. I'll add it for the final version if it finishes, with its scope stated. If it can't be run, the paper will say why.

`dev` is now one commit ahead of `main`: `figtab-repo` updated a provenance hash in `figA_floor_b_sampled.json` after the merge. The plotted data are unchanged, and the hash change will ride with the next candidate.
